title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
A well respected High Street law firm in Haywards Heath are currently seeking an experienced Residential Property Legal Assistant/Conveyancing Assistant to support a small team of experienced Residential Conveyancers.
The successful Residential Property Legal Assistant/Conveyancing Assistant will be responsible for a rage of duties to include:
- File opening/closure
- Conducting AML checks and client due diligence
- Post-completion work
- Ordering searches, completion statements and invoices
- Producing legal documents (via dictation)
- Being the first port of call for clients, Solicitors on the "other side" and other interested parties including estate agents and IFAs

The successful Residential Property Legal Assistant/Conveyancing Assistant will offer the following skill set/background:
- At least 6 months experience in a similar role with a good understanding of the conveyancing process
- Confident communication skills - both written and verbal
- High attention to detail
- A strong work ethic with a "can do" attitude

The successful Residential Property Legal Assistant/Conveyancing Assistant will join a fun and friendly team where there are multiple social events throughout the year, excellent CMS and framework to allow you to succeed in your role and opportunities to progress in time. You will work in modern offices and there is the possibility of hybrid working for the right person.
You will enjoy a market-led salary which is regularly reviewed and a benefits package.

title: Legal Administrator
description:
We are very pleased to be working exclusively alongside our professional, established and friendly client as they seek to recruit a Legal Administrator to join their team on a full time permanent basis

Legal Administrator

East Grinstead town centre area with parking available nearby / off site (approx 5 per day). 10-15 minute walk from East Grinstead station and bus routes.

Full time permanent role - Monday - Thursday (Apply online only) with early finish at 1700 on Fridays. Office based role based in newly appointed very modern offices.

28000 per annum. 20 days holiday (rising to 25 with length of service) plus all UK bank holidays, good pension scheme, birthday leave as an extra day off plus great opportunities to learn and progress within the business.

Are you a law graduate, currently studying law, or looking to build a long-term career within legal services?

My client is looking for a proactive and detail-focused Legal Administrator to join their busy Drafting Department. This is an excellent opportunity to gain hands-on experience within Wills, Lasting Powers of Attorney (LPAs), estate planning, and legal document preparation while working alongside experienced professionals in a supportive and professional environment.

Working closely with a number of departments, you will help guide client matters from instruction through to drafting, registration, and completion, ensuring an exceptional experience throughout the journey.

The role - LegalAdministrator

This role is ideal for someone seeking a first step into the legal profession or looking to develop existing legal administration experience within a growing and specialist sector.

Duties and responsibilities include:

Assist with the preparation, drafting, and amendment of Wills and Lasting Powers of Attorney (LPAs).

Prepare, print, scan, upload, and organise legal documentation

Conduct quality and accuracy checks

Carry out client identity, instruction, and document-completeness checks.

Ensure documentation is reviewed and approved in line with company procedures.

Support the progression of LPAs from initial preparation through to registration

Respond professionally to client and colleague enquiries via telephone and email.

Collaborate with Consultants and internal departments to resolve case-related queries.

Handle confidential and sensitive information

Contribute to continuous improvement of departmental processes and workflows.

Experience, skills and competencies required:

Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Outstanding attention to detail and organisational ability

Strong administrative and document-management skills

Proficient in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Word, and Excel

Able to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately

Comfortable working independently and collaboratively across teams

Studying towards a law qualification, holding a law-related degree, or demonstrating a genuine interest in legal services.

Previous experience within legal administration (desirable not essential)

For more information regarding this new and exciting Legal Administrator opportunity, please apply now! Short-listing will take place soon - don't miss out!

Berry Recruitment Services Ltd T/A First Recruitment Services is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.
